infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Location Wrapped uses your location to save places you visit and create your personal map and recap.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: With your permission, Location Wrapped records location while the app is in the background to build your private visit history. You can pause recording or delete history in Profile.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: Allow Location Wrapped's location library to detect whether you are moving or stationary while recording your location history.
